name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 2 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 2a. Is extremely concerned that defence sector industries have already reaped huge gains from President von der Leyen’s announcement about the ReArm Europe Plan; believes that these industries have already garnered extra profits on the back of the outbreak of the conflict in Ukraine; calls on the Commission to incorporate a mechanism to tax these extra profits in order to fund basic services such as healthcare, education and other basic services in the Member States;
